items.raw_excerpt: 模型参数规模不断突破，推理成本持续下降，开源生态日益繁荣。当模型能力逐渐成为行业共识，一个新的问题开始浮现： 当人人都能获得强大的模型能力之后，真正的竞争力还剩下什么？ 答案正在从模型能力本身，转向围绕模型构建可规模化的智能系统；从单点能力提升，转向系统工程与组织级落地能力。

title_i18n.es: Prácticas de diseño de motores de inferencia LLM de próxima generación para cargas de trabajo agénticas | AICon Shenzhen

excerpt_i18n.zh: 模型参数规模不断突破，推理成本持续下降，开源生态日益繁荣。当模型能力逐渐成为行业共识，一个新的问题开始浮现： 当人人都能获得强大的模型能力之后，真正的竞争力还剩下什么？ 答案正在从模型能力本身，转向围绕模型构建可规模化的智能系统；从单点能力提升，转向系统工程与组织级落地能力。
excerpt_i18n.en: Model parameter scales continue to break records, inference costs keep declining, and the open-source ecosystem is thriving. As model capabilities become an industry consensus, a new question emerges: when everyone can access powerful models, what remains as true competitive advantage? The answer is shifting from model capabilities themselves to building scalable intelligent systems around models, and from improving point capabilities to systems engineering and organization-level deployment capabilities.
excerpt_i18n.es: El tamaño de los parámetros de los modelos sigue superándose, los costos de inferencia continúan disminuyendo y el ecosistema de código abierto es cada vez más próspero. Cuando las capacidades de los modelos se convierten gradualmente en un consenso en la industria, surge una nueva pregunta: cuando todos pueden acceder a capacidades de modelo potentes, ¿qué queda de la verdadera competitividad? La respuesta está pasando de las capacidades del modelo en sí mismas a la construcción de sistemas inteligentes escalables en torno al modelo; de la mejora de capacidades puntuales a la capacidad de ingeniería de sistemas e implementación a nivel organizativo.

items.title: 从 AI 取数到智能分析：企业级数据 Agent 的多阶段演进与工程化落地
items.raw_excerpt: 在大模型技术蓬勃发展的背景下，企业数据消费正从传统的 BI 报表和自助式分析，迈向 AI 原生的 Agent 时代。然而，将学术界看似成熟的 Text-to-SQL 技术落地到复杂的 OLAP 场景中，其准确率可能从纸面上的 90% 骤降至 10%。

title_i18n.zh: 从 AI 取数到智能分析：企业级数据 Agent 的多阶段演进与工程化落地
title_i18n.en: From AI data retrieval to intelligent analysis: multi-stage evolution and engineering implementation of enterprise-level data agents
title_i18n.es: De la extracción de datos por IA al análisis inteligente: evolución multifásica e implementación en ingeniería del agente de datos empresarial.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 在大模型技术蓬勃发展的背景下，企业数据消费正从传统的 BI 报表和自助式分析，迈向 AI 原生的 Agent 时代。然而，将学术界看似成熟的 Text-to-SQL 技术落地到复杂的 OLAP 场景中，其准确率可能从纸面上的 90% 骤降至 10%。
excerpt_i18n.en: Against the backdrop of the booming development of large model technology, enterprise data consumption is transitioning from traditional BI reports and self-service analysis to the AI-native Agent era. However, when applying the seemingly mature Text-to-SQL technology from academia to complex OLAP scenarios, its accuracy may plummet from a theoretical 90% to 10%.
excerpt_i18n.es: En el contexto del floreciente desarrollo de la tecnología de modelos grandes, el consumo de datos empresariales está pasando de los informes tradicionales de BI y el análisis de autoservicio a la era de los agentes nativos de IA. Sin embargo, al implementar la tecnología Text-to-SQL, que parece madura en el ámbito académico, en escenarios complejos de OLAP, su precisión puede caer drásticamente del 90% teórico al 10%.

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, general-purpose humanoid robot company LimX Dynamics announced the completion of nearly $200 million in Pre-IPO financing, with a post-investment valuation of 15 billion yuan, entering the ranks of super-billion-dollar unicorns. The company has raised a total of $400 million over the past six months, laying a solid foundation for future capital market operations. It is reported that this round of financing brought together leading global capital from China, Europe, the Middle East, North America, and Southeast Asia, fully reflecting the global market's recognition of the long-term value of the embodied intelligence industry, as well as confidence in LimX Dynamics' technology roadmap, product capabilities, and globalization strategy. New investors include IDG Capital, Lens Technology, Pan-European industrial investment group G.G.G.Group and Redstone VC, Huashan Capital, and Hefei Binhu Industrial Development Group; Stone Venture from the UAE has invested in multiple consecutive rounds, while existing shareholders such as Oasis Capital, Cornerstone Capital, Nanshan Zhanxin Investment, Shangqi Capital, and NIO Capital have all made additional oversubscriptions. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Shenzhen, LimX Dynamics is an AI-driven general-purpose humanoid robot company focusing on full-size humanoid robot R&D, while also launching innovative products such as the multi-form robot TRON. LimX Dynamics concentrates on three core directions: hardware body design and manufacturing, integrated brain-cerebellum technology, and the embodied intelligence OS system, unleashing AGI's generalization capabilities in the physical world and advancing embodied intelligence in scientific research, commercial, and household domains.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, la empresa de robots humanoides generales LimX Dynamics anunció la finalización de una ronda de financiación Pre-IPO de casi 200 millones de dólares, con una valoración posterior de 15 000 millones de yuanes, entrando en el club de los unicornios de cien mil millones. En los últimos seis meses, la compañía ha acumulado una financiación total de 400 millones de dólares, sentando una base sólida para futuras operaciones en el mercado de capitales. Según se informa, esta ronda de financiación ha contado con capital global de primer nivel de China, Europa, Oriente Medio, América del Norte y el Sudeste Asiático, reflejando el reconocimiento del mercado global al valor a largo plazo de la industria de la inteligencia encarnada, así como la confianza en la trayectoria técnica, la capacidad de producto y la estrategia global de LimX Dynamics. Entre los nuevos inversores se incluyen IDG Capital y Lan Si.

excerpt_i18n.en:
Just as OpenAI released its office agent ChatGPT Work to accelerate its push into the B2B market, its commercial leader unexpectedly stepped down. Recently, Fidji Simo, OpenAI's CEO in charge of "AGI Deployment and Application," publicly announced on social platform X that due to a severe worsening of her chronic neuroimmune disease (POTS) over the past three months, she would resign from her full-time executive role and transition to a part-time advisor. At a critical moment when OpenAI is sprinting toward an IPO and engaging in fierce competition with Anthropic, the unexpected departure of its commercial leader has prompted the outside world to reassess the strengths and uncertainties of this AI giant during its full-scale commercial expansion.  

01 A seven-year covert struggle and an early termination of the "IPO operation"  

For Fidji Simo, this departure is more like a helpless compromise after a seven-year battle with her body. On July 13, Stepfun held a launch event in Shanghai, officially releasing the world's first agent-native operating system Step AOS (Step Agentic-native OS), the personal agent Step Amoo built on the model matrix and Step AOS, and the large model-native AI terminal brand STEPX. Building a runtime environment for agents from scratch. After years of rapid development, AI has arrived at the threshold of the agent era. But for agents to truly enter people's daily lives, smart models alone are not enough. There are three walls ahead: the memory wall, the decision wall, and the action wall.
